title: CORS & Cross-Origin Requests
description: Enable and configure Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) in ASP.NET Core applications.
longDescription: This module explains Cross-Origin Resource Sharing (CORS) and how to enable it in ASP.NET Core applications. You will learn about the same-origin policy, how to configure CORS policies with allowed origins, methods, and headers, and how to apply them globally or per endpoint. You will also learn how CORS preflight requests work and how to troubleshoot common CORS errors in production.
whatYouLearn: Understand the same-origin policy and why CORS is needed
Configure CORS policies with allowed origins, methods, and headers
Apply CORS globally or per controller/endpoint using named policies
Handle CORS preflight requests and customize preflight caching
Debug and troubleshoot common CORS issues in production
